before: A keep-with-next paragraph or kept row before a cantSplit row taller than a page stays beside earlier content, and authored header rows at the top of a page hold such a row beside them.
after: That kept content moves to the next page once, and the row starts on the page after it. Only repeated header rows hold such a row on their page. In mode 15 the page where such a row starts after a move carries no header repeat.
reason: Only body pagination changes. Canonical OOXML, source positions, operations, and collaboration formats remain unchanged.
